schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: UF/DF forms and clears no drug-substance product-quality CQA; no QualityAttribute entities and no DesignSpace are present. The two attributes of @tbl-cqa are monitored only, and are carried as concepts plus step_has_quality_attribute assertions.

No DoE: the plan states that no screening and no response-surface design is planned and that no design space will be claimed, so the only studies are the univariate ranging and the scale-down qualification.
Process-performance measures (buffer exchange, final concentration, step yield, mass balance) have no dedicated field; captured via studies/report_sections/assertions.
Formulation characterization is deferred to the drug product development programme (scope boundary in PTP-001); it is out of scope of this drug-substance pair.
The Plan states classification is an OUTPUT; parameter_type left 'unclassified' here.

process_steps.description: Final ultrafiltration / diafiltration (tangential-flow filtration): ultrafiltration concentrates the virus-filtration pool and diafiltration exchanges it into the final formulation buffer, delivering the drug substance at its target concentration. Forms no product-quality attribute; a formulation / mass-balance operation.

source_references.quote: The UF/DF step concentrates the antibody and exchanges the process buffer for the formulation buffer.
Both operations run across a tangential flow membrane whose pores pass buffer salts and retain the antibody.

statements.statement_text: PCP-010 defines the process characterization study for the A-Mab ultrafiltration and diafiltration step (Step 10).

source_references.quote: This plan defines the process characterization studies for the ultrafiltration and diafiltration step of the A-Mab drug substance process

statements.statement_text: The step forms no critical quality attribute and makes no clearance claim.

source_references.quote: The step is not where the quality attributes of A-Mab are formed.

statements.statement_text: RA-001 assigned every parameter of the step to univariate assessment.

source_references.quote: Proven acceptable ranges (planned analysis) A PAR will be assigned to each parameter from its univariate series.

statements.statement_text: No drug substance attribute is formed or cleared at the step; two attributes are monitored across it.

source_references.quote: The step is the last of the drug substance process, and no step downstream of it clears or modifies either attribute

statements.statement_text: The study will confirm that aggregate content and charge variant distribution are unchanged across the step.

source_references.quote: Determine the effect of the number of diavolumes, the transmembrane pressure and the final DS concentration on the aggregate content and the charge variant distribution of the drug substance

statements.statement_text: No screening and no response-surface design is planned, and no design space will be claimed for the step.

source_references.quote: No response surface model will be fitted for this step, because the design carries no factorial structure and no interaction or curvature term can be estimated from it.
